title: The Prejac Curse
description:
If you want to go in blind (hot) then don’t read any more and give yourself to Goddess Nichole right now, and see what this curse is all about.
Today I have brought you something from the other side. A toxic and corrosive element from your darkest, lustiest dreams. For best results, use stereo headphones, listen in a dark or candle-lit environment and ensure that you have ample privacy and will not be disturbed.

LISTEN AT YOUR OWN DISCRETION. In this file, you and I will make a little agreement. You will offer me something, and I will reward you with the most delicious experience. You definitely won't be better in bed, prejac... not that you can get much worse.🤭

You want this.

Just say Yes Nichole.
author: Goddess Nichole
